scope_review: All three public specifications and their existing proofs are retained.
Full per-program masked source, unmasked signed metadata load, explicit destination cast, successful mathematical flat IO and outside-write frame are present.
The index-commutation equivalence covers complete typed states and failure with no extra numerical law for the nine selected storage pairs.
kv1 masks both head and column padding; kv2 intentionally masks only heads and passes head_dim directly as BLOCK_DMODEL. The review does not repair kv2 to next_power_of_2 or invent a column mask.

structural_gaps.finding: The original wrapper checks matching head dimensions but has no K/Out dtype restriction. The actual public source family enumerates only fp16, bf16 and fp32 independently (nine pairs). Other payload dtypes and their admission or rejection paths are absent; this review does not infer that every unconstrained dtype compiles successfully.

The wrapper forwards DestLoc without a dtype check, while Layout fixes Dest_loc to Region .int and IO.Pins reads one mathematical Int. The actual original test supplies torch.int32. Metadata dtype admission and finite-width representation are not distinguished by this source family; this is separate from the permitted nonnegative-index/bounds input contract.

The wrapper launches DestLoc.shape[0] programs and computes concrete launch widths from K.shape. The public correctness IO quantifies one initial state and s.pids 0; its injectivity condition concerns one output tile. It does not compose the launched sequence, resolve repeated destination indices, or establish cross-program alias/collision requirements. Existing per-program bounds and layout preconditions are legitimate and are preserved.

numerical_boundary: Future native output-conversion assumptions may be recorded per exact dtype/configuration, but cannot cover missing dtype routes or grid composition. Existing real copying and backend equivalence remain partial contracts.

verification.basis: Read original production Python, all public statements and the named key source/IO definitions; bind exact file hashes and evidence lines. No new proof or native execution result claimed.
